description: One repeatable session as a series over its occurrences, to see whether it is improving: give `guide` (a guide's title, e.g. 'PUSH A') or `exercise`, over `weeks` (default 8, max 26) ending at `date`. Uses get_exercise_history's reader (same cache, limit of 8 uncached sessions per call and `pending`: CALL AGAIN until it is 0 before drawing conclusions) and adds duration and TSS. Result: sessions (oldest first) and series per metric with n, first, last, best, better, trend, change. TREND: with 3+ values the median of the older half is compared with the newer half: 'up' / 'down' beyond 3% of the older median, else 'flat'; under 3 values 'insufficient'. No significance test: it says what moved, not that the move is real, and 'up' is not 'better' for every series (see `better`). Weights and reps are what the guide PLANNED unless log_session logged weights. Writes only the history cache.

date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

exercise.description: Exercise name as in get_exercise_history's index. Give this or `guide`.

guide.description: A guide's title, e.g. 'PUSH A' (ignoring case, accents, punctuation). Give this or `exercise`.

name: get_benchmark
title: Get benchmark: a repeatable session over time
